groups.name: Bible Study
groups.description: Various opportunities to delve deeper into Scripture often with members of the Clergy Team

groups.name: OCIA
groups.description: Program for adults who want to enter the Catholic Church

groups.name: Senior Ministry
groups.description: Whether it is cooking and delivering delicious meals, baked cookies, or reaching out to our seniors via phone or card, the Senior Ministry allows you to share your wisdom, experience, and faith as you grow in your faith and serve…

groups.name: Food Bank
groups.description: The Food Bank serves those in our community who have food insecurity. Many hands make light work; if you will like to help and are available one day per month, we would love to have you.

groups.name: Altar Servers
groups.description: Both children and adults have an opportunity to be Altar servers. This could be a great family ministry.

groups.name: Environmental and Decorating Ministry
groups.description: This ministry is a great way to actively contribute to the parish by visually enhancing the worship space, reflecting the liturgical seasons through decorations, and creating a welcoming and beautiful environment.

groups.name: Eucharistic Ministers
groups.description: A Eucharistic Minister is a great way to draw strength from the faithful, grow in devotion, give back to the parish, and aides in our personal desire to become more like Christ's body and blood.

groups.name: Lectors
groups.description: Being a lector is a meaningful way to actively participate in the liturgy by proclaiming the Word of God; essentially you are acting as a "voice of God" for those at Mass

groups.name: Music Ministry / Choir
groups.description: If you like to sing, consider joining the choir. You do not need to read music.

groups.name: Sacristans
groups.description: If you have a respect for others, use discretion and appropriate decorum, and are noted for care to the assembly, you may be someone who should be a Sacristan.

groups.name: Ushers/Greeters
groups.description: Ushers and Greeters help create a welcoming environment and make people feel important.

groups.name: Bereavement Ministry
groups.description: The Bereavement Ministry consists of parish volunteers who are compassionate listeners united in Christ. We help parishioners as they navigate through the grieving process and offer ideas for coping with the loss of a loved one.

groups.name: Faith in Fellowship
groups.description: Faith in Fellowship works on ways to strengthen and reinforce one's religious beliefs through shared experiences and community gatherings.

groups.name: St. Vincent DePaul Society
groups.description: The Society of St. Vincent de Paul (SVP) helps the poor and suffering. You can make a difference with as little as two hours a month.
